ai.name: Kimi K3 (Moonshot AI)
ai.hook: Chinese open model K3 is now being ranked as genuinely near-frontier, not just cheap.
insights: **2.8T params**, 1M-token context, native multimodal input, open weights promised by **July 27**
**Kimi Delta Attention** gives **6.3x faster decoding**, plus ~25% training efficiency gain
Leads **Frontend Code Arena** with a 76% pairwise win rate, above Claude Fable 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol on some benchmarks
ai.for_you: Once open weights drop July 27, this is a serious candidate for a self-hosted coding/agent backend for the agency, cheaper than API calls to closed models for high-volume PT SMB client work.
ai.why_it_made_the_cut: Most-covered story across 4+ sources this week, but today's angle (strategic reassessment) is new

ai.name: Interconnects: 6 months to live for open models
ai.hook: Open-weight AI is facing its most serious viability test right now, not hypothetically.
insights: Strategic shift from **compute moat** to **efficiency stack**: MoE routing, quantization, data curation
Moonshot's **Mooncake infrastructure** treats scarcity (limited GPUs) as a design constraint, not a blocker
**GLM-5.2** already marked a capability threshold; Kimi K3 and Inkling push further this same week
ai.for_you: If open models keep closing the gap, your agency's cost structure for PT SMB clients shifts fast, budget an experiment running one client workflow entirely on an open model this quarter instead of GPT/Claude API.
ai.why_it_made_the_cut: Best synthesis piece connecting this week's scattered model releases into one strategic thesis

ai.name: Craig Mod
ai.hook: Rebuilt his own newsletter tool with AI, cutting a $7,000/year vendor bill to $150.
insights: Replaced Campaign Monitor entirely by building his own send tool
Calls this the start of a **'golden age of tool building'**, bespoke software beating slow incumbents
Still refuses to let AI write his prose, uses it only as a research assistant and builder
ai.for_you: This is the exact pitch you should be making to PT SMBs: not 'add AI chatbot' but 'replace this €X/month SaaS subscription with a small custom tool.' Concrete, priced, sellable.
ai.why_it_made_the_cut: Most directly applicable founder story to Pedro's agency pitch this week

ai.name: Andrej Karpathy
ai.hook: Says there are things you literally can't say inside a frontier AI lab.
insights: Describes structural pressure inside labs to say what the organization wants, not what's true
Frames this as the unresolved founding tension of OpenAI itself
ai.for_you: No direct build action, filed for awareness on how much lab narratives (safety, capability claims) are shaped by internal incentives rather than neutral fact, useful skepticism when reading model release hype.
ai.why_it_made_the_cut: Already surfaced Friday, repeated today but no new development, kept brief for continuity

ai.name: Lila Sciences (Andy Beam & Rafa Gómez-Bombarelli)
ai.hook: The wet lab becomes the verifier, turning science itself into reinforcement learning.
insights: One general model trained on ~10 trillion experimentally-verified tokens beats domain-specific models, **'breadth gives us depth'**
CAR-T candidate designed in six months by two or three people, the **'zero-FTE startup'** model
**'Monster UTRs'** hit ~10x Moderna/Pfizer mRNA expression levels
ai.for_you: No direct action for the agency, filed as a signal that RL-with-verifiable-rewards is expanding beyond code into any domain with a measurable feedback loop, worth remembering if a future SaaS idea has a clear success metric to verify against.
ai.why_it_made_the_cut: Most technically substantive podcast this week, novel framing (lab as data center)

ai.name: Claude Fable 5 goes permanent
ai.hook: Anthropic folds its best model into standard plans starting July 20, at 50% usage limits.

ai.for_you: If you're on Claude Pro for agency prototyping, expect tighter usage caps starting tomorrow, worth checking your current plan's limits before a client deadline.
